name: wave
title: A wave spring: a plunger on legs joined by round bends, squashed in a channel until it stacks solid
orientation: On its side, as drawn: one piece, no supports. Press the plunger: the legs close up evenly, and when they meet the spring stacks solid, its own stop.

body.label: The wave spring, its plunger and the channel in one print

height.rule: How tall it prints: the spring's width

gap.rule: The least gap that prints apart

span.rule: Each leg's length: long, so each bends gently

bend_t.rule: The bends' thickness: the legs' (thicker bends close the gaps between legs, and it stacks solid sooner)

wall.rule: The channel's walls and the base

cap.rule: The plunger's cap over the last leg

button.rule: How far the plunger stands up out of the channel

press.rule: How far a press drives it: nearly to solid

room.rule: Room between the bends and the channel's walls, for them to spread as it squashes

stop.rule: How far the plunger can go before its wings meet the ledges: past a press, short of the spring's limit

ledge.rule: How far the ledges stand in from the walls: under the wings, clear of the bends

round.rule: Rounds where the spring's end legs meet the base and the plunger
